facts.fact: The World Bank-backed Smart Villages project, run by the national information society agency ANSI, aims to connect 2,175 villages to 3G/4G and install 124 multiservice digital centres, according to its coordinator.
facts.system: Projet Villages Intelligents pour la croissance rurale et l'inclusion numérique

facts.fact: The project coordinator says the work fits within the National Digital Development Strategy launched in 2020; the document gives no adoption act.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Développement du Numérique
